capabilities: Display property-based titles in link suggester, quick switcher, tab titles, graph view, backlinks, bookmarks, window frame, and file explorer
Search notes by property, file name, or aliases with configurable fuzzy search
Insert property-based links via the link suggester
Create new notes from the link suggester and quick switcher
Support folder notes, drag-and-drop linking, and MDX files
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is part of the Vault CMS project, and the README advertises Zeku, a paid desktop writing app from the same developer with a 14-day free trial.
intentEvidence: Displays property (like title) in link suggester, quick switcher, graph view, tab titles, backlinks, bookmarks, window frame, and file explorer.
problem: Obsidian identifies and shows notes by file name everywhere, which is awkward when the meaningful title lives in a note property.

relations.evidence: adapted from the Title-only Tab plugin by tristone13th
are adapted from the Front Matter Title plugin by snezhig
relations.plugin: Front Matter Title plugin by snezhig

relations.evidence: Particularly helpful when used in conjunction with Astro Composer Obsidian plugin

summary: Property-based titling plugin that displays and searches notes by a chosen property (like title) instead of the file name across the interface.
